title: Rocky Road Festival Tasting Sessions
summary: Every Sunday in May at Mornington Peninsula Chocolaterie (Flinders): sample 8 Rocky Road flavours, a Rocky Road hot chocolate and ice cream, then build your own to take home. $28pp, 11am / 12pm / 1:30pm sessions.
accessibilityNotes: Ground floor accessible; check site for wheelchair access
nearbyAttractions: Flinders Village; Flinders Truffles farm gate; Flinders Golf Course
suggestedItineraryPairing: Pair with Flinders Truffles farmgate visit and a seaside walk at Flinders pier; ideal family day
editorVerdict: A genuinely fun family Sunday at the Chocolaterie, and one of the rare paid kids' activities that is honestly priced for what you get.
editorNote:
Every Sunday in May at Mornington Peninsula Chocolaterie in Flinders. The session runs about 90 minutes: eight Rocky Road flavours to sample, a Rocky Road hot chocolate and ice cream, then you build a rocky road to take home. Three sessions a Sunday (11am, 12pm, 1:30pm), limited spots, book ahead.

$28 per person plus booking fee. Children and adults priced the same, which is fair given everyone gets the full kit.

The Flinders pairing is the obvious one: tasting first, then the pier walk, Flinders Truffles farm gate if it's open, late lunch at the pub. Indoor and weather-independent, useful insurance against a wet May Sunday.
